Need to search first.I couldn't write these notes. My attempts to reach the sources failed, and I ran out of research tool calls before I could read a single page on Ezekiel 42.

Here's what went wrong:

- **First attempt:** I tried to open six pages directly: Enduring Word, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on BibleHub, Matthew Henry on StudyLight, and the NET Bible notes. All six were refused because the tool only opens addresses that have already come up in a search, and I hadn't searched yet.
- **Second attempt:** When I went back to run the searches, the tool told me I had no calls left.

So I have no material from any of the approved sites for Ezekiel 42. Your rules say to report only what the pages say, with a URL for every point, and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Writing verse notes now would mean making up content and citations, so I haven't written any.

**Next steps:** If you ask again in a new message, I'll search first and then open the pages that come up. I'll start with the verse-by-verse commentaries (Enduring Word, BibleHub/StudyLight for Gill, Ellicott and Pulpit, Precept Austin). Then I'll look at the tradition-specific sites and the NET Bible, Catholic and Orthodox sources.
